{{Top|leg}}
The '''Retribution feedback shield''' was a type of shielding technology that was created by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Clan Deshra]] almost a [[Standard century/Legends|century]] before the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Reverse-engineered from [[Alien/Legends|alien]] technologies, the Retribution shield was adapted as both [[Starship/Legends|starship]] shields and personal energy shields. The shields were only moderately strong, but could be activated with an energy charge that responds to enemy attacks with energy feedback that damaged the attacking starship.
